blocks.text: Group 1 ke elements alkali metals kehlate hain kyun ke yeh pani se react kar ke alkalis (pani mein hal hone wale bases) banate hain. Sodium aur potassium is ki mashhoor misalein hain. In mein ek valence electron hota hai, density kam, melting point relatively (kuch had tak) kam aur ionization energy kam hoti hai. Yeh sab se zyada reactive metals hain.
